title: Cybersecurity experts claim that AI leaders' apocalyptic hacking predictions are technically incoherent and reflect an unfamiliarity with the subject (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
summary: Kevin Collier / NBC News: Cybersecurity experts claim that AI leaders' apocalyptic hacking predictions are technically incoherent and reflect an unfamiliarity with the subject — Cybersecurity experts told NBC News that they were concerned that fundamental issues of cybersecurity weren't being addressed.
